source.section: Liquidity and Capital Resources — Net Cash Used in Investing Activities
source.quote: The $0.6 million used in investing activities in the three months ended April 30, 2026 was comprised of $0.6 million for the purchase of property and equipment and leasehold improvements.

source.section: Liquidity and Capital Resources — Stock Repurchase Programs
source.quote: we repurchased 6.1 million shares of our outstanding common stock for $110.5 million (inclusive of $16.9 million in treasury stock not yet settled)

source.section: Note 4. Revenues — Deferred Revenue and Remaining Performance Obligations
